proof_scope: offline real-path scene_script.scene_table.v1 -> create-kling-scene -> best-practices-kling-video validation; no paid provider submit

claims.proves: A valid scene table + refs deterministically compiles to a PASS receipt with typed final instructions, required fact coverage, positional @ElementN binding, typed voice purpose validation, and a paid-submit next_command; invalid scene rows, missing refs, fake images, too-short WAVs, and unresolvable triage block fail-closed.
claims.does_not_prove: Live paid Kling submission, generated video quality, fal upload/public URL reachability, or post-generation clip audit.

capability_claims.description: Canonical scene-table to validated Kling packet compiler gate with media/readback seams.

cases.name: nonfixture-real-path-compiler-gate
command:
cd .. && T=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf "$T"' EXIT; python3 - <<PY2
import json, zlib, struct
scene={"schema":"scene_script.scene_table.v1","scene_id":"nonfixture-tea","environment":{"location":"windy stone terrace","time_of_day":"dusk","weather":"dry electrical storm","temperature":"cold air","humidity":"arid air","wind":"steady left-to-right wind","light_sources":["lightning","table lantern"],"light_behavior":"lightning flickers across faces","ambient_sound":"wind over stone"},"elements":[{"element_id":"character_embry","element_type":"character","description":"brown-haired woman in gray jacket","environment_interaction":"wind moves loose hair strands","action":"leans toward evidence map"},{"element_id":"character_horus","element_type":"character","description":"bald armored giant seated calmly","environment_interaction":"lantern highlights gold armor edges","action":"turns one teacup toward Embry"},{"element_id":"prop_tea","element_type":"prop","description":"white porcelain tea service","environment_interaction":"steam bends sideways in wind"}]}
json.dump(scene, open('$T/scene.json','w'))
def png(p):
    raw=b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n'
    def chunk(t,d):
        return struct.pack('>I',len(d))+t+d+struct.pack('>I',zlib.crc32(t+d)&0xffffffff)
    ihdr=chunk(b'IHDR', struct.pack('>IIBBBBB',64,64,8,0,0,0,0)); row=b'\x00'+b'\x88'*64; idat=chunk(b'IDAT', zlib.compress(row*64,0)); open(p,'wb').write(raw+ihdr+idat+chunk(b'IEND',b''))
png('$T/embry.png'); png('$T/horus.png')
PY2
./run.sh build --scene "$T/scene.json" --refs embry="$T/embry.png" --refs horus="$T/horus.png" --out-dir "$T/out" >/dev/null
python3 - <<PY3
import json
r=json.load(open('$T/out/receipt.json')); i=json.load(open('$T/out/kling_instructions.json'))
assert r['status']=='PASS', r
assert set(i['required_fact_ids']) <= set(i['covered_fact_ids']), i
assert i['references'][0]['sha256'].startswith('sha256:'), i['references']
print('PASS nonfixture real-path compiler gate')
PY3

stdout_contains: PASS negative-control scene gate + triage code
PASS binding-order-control (reversed CLI order rebinds positionally)
